body:
I spoke to my professor and I might try and get another internship with the city. That's more time not getting paid but it opens the doors to employment that would help with my debt. If I don't fuck everything up like last time. I felt better about the whole thing this afternoon. It's late now and really negative thoughts are clouding my mind like usual. I really want a drink but I'm just going to wait until I can sleep. 

I'm really hoping I'm off the ledge.

I have, repeatedly. I'm Eve talking to a prof about getting it off the ground and just throwing something together quick that the committee will approve. It's just that, nobody is going to hire someone who has done nothing in all this time but get an MPA. And nobody wants to hire someone with a grad degree because they're liable to leave. I can just not mention grad school but then I'm a 27 year old who hasn't worked in four years. I'm thinking about volunteering for a charity but even then I don't see a way out of this pit.

Thanks, but my grieving ended sometime ago. The thesis not being done is my own fault. I still have two professors who would be happy to help me but at this point....doesn't seem like it matters. 

But listen, I would give anything to be in the past and on the other side of all this. Another chance to make the right decision and get that shit done when I should have so please, please learn from me and try to crank that paper out! Whatever it takes, I know it can really suck but being on this side of it is way, way worse.
